saturnus 0.2.0 brings the transfer tool satx into the project: one tag now
releases two command-line tools, `saturnus` (the emulator) and `satx`
(Kermit and XModem transfers to a real HP 48 or 49 over a serial cable).
The site moved to a landing page with the emulator under it.

## Get it

- **Web page**, nothing to install: <https://ractive.ch/saturnus/>, the
  emulator at <https://ractive.ch/saturnus/emulator/>. Kept ROMs and
  states stay where they were; install the web app again from the new
  address.
- **Command line**:
  - `cargo install saturnus`, `cargo install satx`;
  - Homebrew (macOS, Linux): `brew trust --formula ractive/tap/saturnus`
    once, then `brew install ractive/tap/saturnus` and
    `brew install ractive/tap/satx`;
  - Scoop (Windows): `scoop bucket add ractive https://github.com/ractive/scoop-bucket`,
    then `scoop install saturnus` and `scoop install satx`;
  - the archives below, `saturnus-v0.2.0-<target>` and
    `satx-v0.2.0-<target>` (checksums in `saturnus-SHA256SUMS` and
    `satx-SHA256SUMS`), or the Linux x86_64 packages `saturnus` and
    `satx` (.deb, .rpm, statically linked).
- **Desktop app**: `.dmg` (macOS, Apple silicon, signed and notarised),
  `.msi` or `-setup.exe` (Windows x86_64), `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.AppImage`
  (Linux x86_64). Its Linux package is now `saturnus-app`, so it installs
  next to the command line's `saturnus`.
- **Libraries** on crates.io, all at 0.2.0: `saturnus-core` (the core, no
  dependencies, builds for `wasm32`), `saturnus-objects`,
  `saturnus-host`, `saturnus-drive`, and satx's `kermit-proto`,
  `xmodem-proto` and `satx-core`.

## Renamed, with no compatibility for the old names

- The core library is the crate `saturnus-core` (`use saturnus_core::…`);
  the crate `saturnus` is now the command-line tool. `saturnus-cli` gets
  no new versions.
- The CLI's Linux package is `saturnus`, the desktop app's
  `saturnus-app`.
- The checksums file `SHA256SUMS` is now one per tool.

## New

- **satx**: send and receive files with an HP 48 or 49 by Kermit or
  XModem, from the command line, against a real calculator or the
  emulator. Shell completions come in its archives and packages.
- **Screen to a variable… and Screen to stack**: the display goes onto
  the calculator as a 131 × 64 graphic. Also `saturnus ctl screen
  --to-var NAME` and `--to-stack`.
- **Saved states work alike in the browser and the app**, one per model
  at a click, plus `.sat` files that also load in `saturnus run --load`.
- **A guided tour** of the page, offered once on a first visit.
- **The command line's macOS binaries are signed and notarised.**

The memory view, the dialogs, the ROM table, the messages and the docs
were reworked along the way; see `CHANGELOG.md` for the full list.

## The Windows installers are not signed

SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC": click "More info", then
"Run anyway".

## ROMs are not included

saturnus ships no ROM. `saturnus rom fetch --model <m>`, the web page and
the app download the images hpcalc.org offers for use with emulators,
after asking. The HP 42S ROM was never released: dump your own
calculator (see the README).

## Clean room and AI notice

saturnus is written from public hardware documentation and the observed
behaviour of the calculators' own ROMs, not from the source code of other
emulators, and contains no HP logos or wordmarks. Parts of the code were
generated by AI systems under human supervision; see `AI_NOTICE`. MIT
licence.
